# Independently authored weak-edge Shape corpus

`itk-5.4.json` contains 504 cases, 77 input blobs, 3826700 input-voxel visits, the full precomparison authoring contract, and public results. Six original Shape expectations from `../edge_levelset/itk-5.4.json` remain protected byte for byte; the498 other outputs are public-oracle observations until Go qualification. Plane/weak-radial/protected families retain fixed geometric criteria. Boundary/domain/public-API families are characterizations and must retain their PASS/RED observations without being counted as parity acceptance. No case was dropped or retried.

`generate.py` authors only finite float32 inputs from the exact contract and copies protected masks; it does not import ITK or calculate new expected masks. To reproduce inputs, extract `authoring_contract` from this corpus to a temporary JSON file, then use `--contract`, `--protected` and `--output`. The protected argument is the original edge corpus. Verify the generated input SHA256 dce4cd80d97ea65c1fb9b2c6e6e8ca7f0f0039f4771a4cc3c9927925ce9fd845. No generator input or criterion may change after comparison.

`oracle.cpp` is an independently authored public API harness, compiled against pinned public ITK 5.4.5 f51594ad88194a72cdc06a314dafff709fcdc2e9. It verifies fresh defaults before setters: interpolation false, layers 2 in 2D/3 in 3D, physical spacing true, minimal curvature false, reverse false, isovalue 0 and native dt 1/(2D). C++ public ValueType scalings/isovalue are float32, whereas timestep/RMS settings are double. The harness SHA256 is be037af5756c8ab1f5a1081ffb7ab0d62aef1e984afae01cf0c76cd04d67f0f9. It does not include upstream implementation/fixtures. SimpleITK 2.5.3 used for the six protected outputs reports ITK 5.4.5; its original generator did not override interpolation/layers/timestep defaults.

G1's incorrect default declarations and both exit2 results are preserved in external evidence. G2 metadata changed global declarations only; all 77 blobs, six protected fixtures and fixed criteria remained identical. G2's first campaign remains STOP at a float32-versus-double validation guard after 181 unique executions. Recovery was a separate 120-second authorization: reclassify output 180 without Update, execute 181..503 once, preserve the STOP and all raws. Recovery completed 23.39379 s; G2 took 16.86407 s. All 504 executions were finite and process groups were reaped. Six protected masks and observations matched exactly. No hidden deadline renewal or accepted Go equivalence follows from these public executions.

Public ITK is a behavioural/mathematical oracle under its Apache-2.0/NumFOCUS notices. Corpus input formulas, harness and Go implementation are independently authored. Grid-centre sampling, layers=D and native timestep bounds are global canonical settings. The 48 public interpolation/layer variants remain diagnostic; no best-per-case selection is permitted. Boundaries are evaluated on the entire authored domain, including all faces, edges and corners, both propagation signs, translations and caller-authored padding.
